Told what to do without ever trying it

lonly Hearts and lonly solos break lose from

Difficulties still we cry for more.

2 aot Thoughts on life...
See-Saw
swing, swing, swing
see-saw
swing, swing
up then down
smile then frown
lefts and rights and wrongs
and thoughts then words
then poems then songs
sun up, sun set
fantasy and regret
heaven & hell
to know and tell
to say and do
to lie to be true
to fight and lose
to fight and win
to fight and call a truce
to end just to begin
to ride the see-saw
to fall off then try again
to hide the see saw
to love to sin

she's the best I've seen, I wrote her a letter,

so many choices can rinse your life down the drain.

you're behind number four, I can see it in your eyes,
I should turn the key so you can showme the way.
If you cost money - then gladly I'll pay.
I've got to stop this livin goin day to day.
When everythings said and done this is the price I pay.
You gotta turn the next page, start over again,
sort out your acquaintances and weed out your friends.
It's hard to see when the smoke fills your eyes,
Hard to know whats right in a world full of lies.
pure
Through trial and error you' [...cut for the check]

hide
You've come all this way to be at my
Side

This man I met

Can't see so clear

Any where from here

Turn off gravity

Because only you hold the key

Major League Baseball's influence around the world

Chronology
Aug. 16-18, 1996: San Diego Padres host a three-game series against the New York Mets in Monterrey, Mexico, marking the first MLB regular-season games outside the USA or Canada.

MLBI foreign broadcast rights-holders include:
NBC Europe
Channel 5 (England)
TBS, NHK, FUJI-TV (Venezuela)
Televisa (Mexico)
TSN (Canada)

April 4, 1999: The Padres and Colorado Rockies open the regular season in Monterrey, the first MLB regular-season opener outside the USA or Canada.

March 29-30, 2000: The Chicago Cubs and New York Mets open the season in Tokyo, the first time MLB will open the season outside of North America.

Last April, MLBI signed an agreement with ITV in Korea that will enable more fans to see more than 100 games per season, including live coverage of the All-Star game, World Series and each of Chan Ho Park's starts for the Los Angeles Dodgers.

Professional players not on a 40-man major league roster will compete in the Olympics in Sydney, Australia, for the first time, Sept. 15-Oct. 1.

A new initiative is to help the Greece federation for its host role at the 2004 Olympics.
